{{Quote|We've got ourselves a ''Hutt problem''. Two ''low-lifes'' called ''Bo-Dum'' and ''Rarsk'' acting like they ''own'' the planet.|Jenna to Han Solo|<ref name="TCK" />}}
This '''unidentified planet''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[File:Unidentified_planet_Jenna_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Two [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] in the planet's red dunes]]
This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] housed a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corellian settlement|settlement]]. At some point, the planet was taken over by [[Bo-Dum]] and [[Rarsk (Hutt)|Rarsk]], two minor [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] who had been evicted from the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Following the murder of [[Jenna's father|their]] [[Sheriff/Legends|sheriff]], the Corellian settlers remained at the mercy of the two Hutts, until the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] [[Skirmish on unidentified planet (Jenna)|intervened]].<ref name="TCK" />
